story_lore_boundary.note: Epra, Orsus, dragons, Weyrs, Tower Administration, psi ranks, Anael, Ace, Leo, and related story-world facts remain source lore. Only interaction and systems mechanisms may transfer after explicit design review.

mechanisms.description: A very strong sender must actively attenuate output so the same signal can be useful at human-scale, group-scale, and long-range scale.
mechanisms.codex_use: Treat projected presence, alerts, audio, glow, motion, and agent salience as gain-controlled channels. High capability should not imply maximum visual or acoustic intensity.

mechanisms.description: Multi-thread training allows several simultaneous operations without collapsing them into one undifferentiated task.
mechanisms.codex_use: Represent concurrent operations as visible lanes/orbits with independent progress, provenance, and attention state rather than one overloaded activity spinner.

mechanisms.description: Telekinetic control is depicted as precise enough for buttons, typing, cargo handling, and coordinated work at distance.
mechanisms.codex_use: Use remote pointer/gesture affordances for selecting, nudging, grouping, and routing holographic objects while retaining accessible conventional controls underneath.

mechanisms.description: Anael is described as especially good at transmitting detailed visuals to different classes of receivers.
mechanisms.codex_use: Support one-to-one, room, group, and wide-broadcast projection modes with explicit audience scope and preserved source identity.

mechanisms.description: Ideas are rapidly translated into technical drawings, maps, buildings, and vehicle designs.
mechanisms.codex_use: Let drawn glyphs/diagrams graduate into structured manipulable system objects without losing the originating stroke/provenance layer.

mechanisms.description: Diagnostic perception is distinct from the ability to perform healing or repair.
mechanisms.codex_use: Keep inspect/diagnose and mutate/repair as separate capabilities and separate UI states. Detecting a problem must never silently imply authority to change it.

mechanisms.description: A bonded companion is used as a stabilising presence while remaining its own agent with quirks and independent behaviour.
mechanisms.codex_use: Caretaker/guide companions may provide stabilisation, reminders, and context without becoming hidden authority or replacing user control.

candidate_visuals: gain halo that expands/contracts without changing identity
remote manipulation filaments from hand/pointer to object
diagram ink extruding into labelled holographic geometry
diagnostic overlays that remain visually distinct from repair controls
ui_translation.rule: Capability intensity, output intensity, and mutation authority are three different things.

candidate_animation_grammar: sense -> scope -> attenuate/amplify -> engage one or more lanes -> manipulate/inspect -> propose or act within authority -> receipt -> return to baseline
